summary: Safety and ethics policy for any addiction-pattern or recovery-support content in the knowledge base.
body: Addiction-related astrology content is sensitive, optional, and non-clinical. It must be framed as pattern awareness with constructive support, never as diagnosis, inevitability, shame, or medical guidance.
definition: A review policy governing how addiction-support interpretations can be authored, reviewed, and surfaced.
appUsage: Require human review before changing any addiction-support status beyond DRAFT.
Keep this content behind an app-level sensitive-content toggle unless a separate product decision says otherwise.
If a user signals active struggle, crisis, or risk, prioritize support options over astrological interpretation.
Use region-appropriate support resources and avoid categorical promises about outcomes.
note: Imported from the project support bundle. Source files were not copied into the repository.

principles: Descriptive, not deterministic. A chart never causes, predicts, or excuses addiction.
Never diagnostic. This content is not medical or clinical advice and does not replace care.
Recovery-oriented. Difficulty is workable; the chart is a mirror for awareness, paired always with action and support.
Agency first. The person, not the planets, is the author of change.
prohibitedFramings: Any 'your chart dooms you to addiction' or inevitable framing.
Romanticizing, glamorizing, or normalizing substance use or any addictive behavior.
Using astrology to delay, substitute for, or argue against professional treatment.
Dwelling on or sensationalizing overdose losses or specific named tragedies.
Clinical or diagnostic claims about a person's mind, body, or substance use.
requiredFramings: Pair every pattern with a constructive channel and a pointer toward real support.
State plainly that recovery is possible and help exists.
Keep the energy workable, not a sentence.

safety.activeStruggle: If a user signals active struggle, crisis, or risk, the product leads with support options, not an astrological explanation. Astrology never rationalizes or replaces care.
safety.resources: Surface region-appropriate support. For US users, an example is the SAMHSA National Helpline, 1-800-662-4357 (free, confidential, 24/7). Do not make categorical promises about confidentiality or outcomes; let users choose.
safety.doNot: Do not provide instructions, dosing, sourcing, or any how-to relating to substances.

classes.reviewGate: All addiction/recovery content stays DRAFT until reviewed against this policy. This policy needs human sign-off before any such content ships READY.

weighting: Ethics policy overrides interpretive style when there is conflict.
Clinical safety overrides astrological explanation when a user indicates active risk.
No addiction-support entry can ship without review against this policy.
